graphs: models/onnx/moonshine-tiny-fp32 (own fp32 export from the validated checkpoint)
text: And so my fellow Americans ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.
root_cause_fixed: the export wrapper passed encoder_hidden_states=None, and MoonshineAttention gates the whole cross-attention block on that argument, so every layer traced the self-attention branch. Sensitivity probe after the fix: max abs logit difference against a zeroed cross_past is 27.01 (was 0.0), and the first-step argmax became 1126, matching the oracle.

long_form.reading: the seed-cache shape blocker is gone and any length now runs, but the transcript is junk on a 31 s clip. The emitted ids are byte-fallback tokens, which points at input outside the model's training window rather than a graph fault. Long-form quality is NOT claimed.

artifacts_dropped: the 32 MB seed cache AND the 13,824-byte BOS self-attention block are both gone. Cross-attention is computed in-graph and self-attention starts empty, matching PyTorch's DynamicCache. The earlier seed experiments all failed because cross-attention was dead, which made the seed look load-bearing.
still_open: streaming and partial-result behaviour: needs the moonshine-streaming checkpoint, which ships safetensors only, so it is a separate port rather than a measurement
the hard ban improves selection but does not recover punctuation or casing; a proper sampling or beam policy is unmeasured

long_form_quality.text: Daughter of a year with the birds of a year with the birds of a year with the birds of a year with...
long_form_quality.reading: Long-form audio beyond 30 s decodes to substantially correct text under greedy selection when recently emitted tokens are banned. 2329 frames, about 56 s.
long_form_quality.next_thing_to_try: SUPERSEDED: a soft repetition penalty of 1.1 left the output unchanged, which only shows the penalty was too weak. The hard ban settles it.

repetition_penalty_probe.conclusion: penalty too weak to be decisive; it does NOT exonerate greedy decoding
repetition_penalty_probe.withdrawn_claim: an earlier version of this receipt read identical output as proof that greedy decoding was not the cause. That inference was invalid.

hard_ban_probe.text: of a year with the birds. Of all, you're worth The Birds! This is a LibriVox recording All LibriVox Recording These are in public domain For more information or to follow
hard_ban_probe.conclusion: the repetition loop is a selection artifact, not the model window. Long audio decodes correctly once the decoder cannot re-emit the last 40 tokens.
hard_ban_probe.withdrawn_claim: the earlier model-window explanation is refuted by this run.
